# Listen to Stryker Chair and CEO Kevin Lobo on Bain & Company’s Founder’s Mentality podcast


##### 09-Jul-2026


#####


Stryker Chair and CEO Kevin Lobo recently sat down with Bain & Company’s Jimmy Allen to discuss the leadership principles and decision-making approach that have shaped his tenure as Stryker’s CEO, and how our company structure and culture fuel our innovation and growth.


[Listen to the podcast episode](https://lnk.to/FM-kevin-loboPL)
